name: slack-mcp
description: Slack (messaging): me, send, reply, get_thread, list_inbound, mark_read. Every tool maps to a docume

platform_mcp_slack_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SLACK_TOKEN
platform_mcp_slack_token.description: Bot token (xoxb-…) of an installed Slack app, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' ('You must transmit your token as a bearer token in the Authorization HTTP header', https://docs.slack.dev/apis/web-api/). Scopes: chat:write (send, reply); channels:history, groups:history, im:history, mpim:history (list_inbound, get_thread); channels:manage, channels:write, groups:write, im:write or mpim:write (mark_read).

tools.name: me
tools.description: auth.test 'checks authentication and tells you who you are' (no scopes required); account carries url, team, user, team_id, user_id, bot_id.

tools.name: send
tools.description: `to` is the Slack channel argument: 'an encoded ID or channel name that represents a channel, private group, or IM channel'. `subject` and `channel` are ignored. message_id is the message `ts`. Slack allows about 1 message per second per channel.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: `thread_id` is the parent message `ts` (sent as thread_ts); `channel` is REQUIRED by Slack alongside thread_ts — without it Slack answers ok:false (isError).

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: `thread_id` is the parent message `ts`; `channel` ('Conversation ID to fetch thread from') is REQUIRED by Slack. Slack pages by cursor (response_metadata.next_cursor), not by page number: `page` is ignored and only the first `limit` messages are returned; `id` is the message ts (Unix time with fraction). New non-Marketplace commercial apps: 1 request/minute, limit <= 15.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: Lists ONE channel: `channel` ('Conversation ID to fetch history for') is REQUIRED by Slack — there is no cross-conversation inbox method. `since` is not sent (Slack's `oldest` is a Unix timestamp, not ISO-8601); Slack pages by cursor, so `page` is ignored and only the newest `limit` messages are returned. New non-Marketplace commercial apps: 1 request/minute, limit <= 15.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: 'Sets the read cursor in a channel': `channel` and `message_id` (the message `ts`, 'Unique identifier of message you want marked as most recently seen') are both required by Slack; `thread_id` is not used. Slack asks not to 'make calls to this method very often'.
